purpose: Continue cross-circumference support accumulation without repeatedly polling only Sep10 targets while preserving all frozen evidence and RESULT boundaries.
principles: Sep10 Nara/Kawasaki execution chain remains unchanged and independently monitored.
Historical PIT Fast Track frozen window and venue pool MUST NOT be expanded or repaired.
Only prospective pre-event evidence captured before the applicable PIT cutoff may enter this continuity lane.
RESULT, payout, odds, forecasts, comments, predictions and post-race-derived information remain forbidden.
S0 remains frozen; no feature, beta, fit, calibration, promotion or production mutation is authorized.
Schedule or assen membership alone never increments support.
A rider increments support only after PRE membership, official registration identity, contemporaneous official same-race assignment, provenance and cross-circumference pairing all pass.
Ambiguity, missed cutoff, transport failure, identity conflict, assignment conflict or provenance failure closes that candidate without repair.

continuity_lane.event_selection_rule: Select future events only through positively observed official navigation; never guess race IDs or racecard URLs.
continuity_lane.capture_rule: When an exact Day1 racecard becomes positively observable, run the existing PIT cutoff extractor, positive Day1 manifest builder and prospective PRE acquisition chain before cutoff.
continuity_lane.identity_rule: Use official KEIRIN.JP registration number as identity truth; name-only or fuzzy equality is insufficient.
continuity_lane.assignment_rule: Require positive contemporaneous official same-race assignment before support receipt.
continuity_lane.receipt_rule: Only complete cross-circumference pairs receive formal support receipts.
continuity_lane.recompute_rule: After every new formal receipt batch, recompute every frozen support adequacy dimension, not only rider count.

while_waiting: prepare reusable prospective event discovery and capture queue
validate fail-closed offline fixtures for multi-event orchestration
identify future positively observed 333/333.33m and 400m event opportunities without opening RESULT
execute PRE capture only when exact racecard and cutoff conditions are satisfied

owner_reporting_contract.terminology_rule: When specialist terminology or English is used in owner-facing reporting, append a concise Japanese meaning or translation.
owner_reporting_contract.handoff_rule: Every future handoff must include this reporting contract and the latest roadmap/current-position snapshot.
owner_reporting_contract.style: iPhone-first, result-first, concise; do not ask owner to carry routine recovery context.
